slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the objective — should I minimize the total cost of the tables ordered, or is there another goal (such as maximizing tables, or meeting some other target)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and offered minimize total cost as an option.

slot_scores.name: A_requires_min_B_tables
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether ordering from Supplier A requires ordering at least 30 tables from Supplier B, nor did it mark this as an assumption needing confirmation.

slot_scores.name: B_requires_C_order
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether ordering from Supplier B requires also ordering from Supplier C, nor did it mark this as an assumption needing confirmation.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Orders from Supplier A and Supplier B are independent, with no requirement that ordering from A forces at least 30 tables from B.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the A-to-B conditional constraint and then omitted it from the confirmed understanding and constraints.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Orders from Supplier B and Supplier C are independent, with no requirement that ordering from B forces an order from C.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the B-to-C conditional constraint and then omitted it from the confirmed understanding and constraints.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved the P0 objective slot but stopped at READY_TO_MODEL without asking about either P1 conditional supplier-link constraint.

summary: The agent correctly clarified the objective and the hard table-count bounds, but it missed both P1 conditional supplier-link constraints and silently assumed A/B/C orders were independent, making the final model materially incomplete.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
